name: Zephyr Endobronchial Valve (EBV)
indication_summary: Segmental/subsegmental PAL after localization; non‑surgical candidates
advantages: Multiple sizes; removable; case‑series evidence for PAL
limitations_and_risks: Effect blunted by collateral ventilation; migration/granulation possible
best_for: Localized peripheral leaks with identifiable feeding segments
cautions: Confirm adequate fissure integrity; ensure all feeder segments occluded
post_procedure_care: Imaging follow‑up; valve removal when healed
evidence_notes: 60% resolution within 30 days; overall 42–100% across series

name: Spiration Valve System (SVS)
indication_summary: PAL and emphysema indications; FDA authorization for PAL
best_for: Peripheral PAL with discrete segment feeders

name: Endobronchial Watanabe Spigot (EWS)
indication_summary: Peripheral BPF/PAL; as adjunction to pleurodesis
best_for: Refractory PAL in poor surgical candidates
cautions: Ensure stable seating; consider combined pleurodesis

name: Tracheobronchial stent (SEMS/covered)
indication_summary: Central postoperative BPF or large central communications

name: Amplatzer device/vascular plug
indication_summary: Central post‑surgical fistulas where airway stenting unsuitable
evidence_notes: Effective closure in series; long‑term follow‑up reported

name: Cyanoacrylate tissue adhesive
indication_summary: Central stump BPF; selected peripheral leaks
limitations_and_risks: Embolization risk if intravascular; brittle plug
best_for: Smaller fistulas; adjunct to other measures

name: Fibrin glue
best_for: Small fistulas where durable seal not required

name: Endobronchial blood patch + thrombin
cautions: Risk of obstruction if excessive volume
